# @radui1398/pdf-merger-js

> Merge PDFs in browsers using File, Blob or byte arrays. No CLI or Commander dependency.

Version: 6.0.1. ESM package.

Install: `npm install @radui1398/pdf-merger-js`.

Import: `import PDFMerger from '@radui1398/pdf-merger-js'`.

# @radui1398/pdf-merger-js

Browser PDF merger. Version 6 exports the browser implementation by default; Node.js users should migrate to `@radui1398/pdf-merger-js-node`.

```sh
npm install @radui1398/pdf-merger-js
```

```js
import PDFMerger from '@radui1398/pdf-merger-js'

const merger = new PDFMerger()
await merger.add(file) // File, Blob, Uint8Array, ArrayBuffer, URL or URL string
await merger.add(otherFile, '1-3')
const blob = await merger.saveAsBlob()
await merger.save('merged') // Downloads merged.pdf
```

`saveAsBuffer()` returns a Uint8Array. `reset()` starts a fresh document; `setMetadata()` accepts producer, author, title and creator. The constructor accepts optional pdf-lib load options.

`/web` and `/browser` alias the default export. `/core` exports `PDFMergerBase` and `parsePagesString`. The only direct runtime dependency is `@cantoo/pdf-lib`; no CLI or Commander is installed.

## Agent documentation

The npm package includes `llms.txt` (documentation index) and `llms-full.txt` (standalone usage guide and TypeScript API). These files are generated from the package metadata, README, generated public declarations and shared usage guidance.

The library is authored in TypeScript and ships compiled ESM and generated declarations in `dist/`. Consumers use the same package imports without a build step.

## Input validation and cancellation

`await merger.add(input, pages, { signal, timeoutMs: 30000 })` supports cancellation and a timeout covering the whole download. Use `timeoutMs: 0` to disable it. Valid values are integers from 0 to 2,147,483,647. HTTP failures reject with the status code. Cancellation is checked before adding pages; synchronous PDF parsing cannot be interrupted. Await calls sequentially.

Page selections use positive safe integers, preserve order and duplicates, and are limited to 100,000 pages. Invalid or out-of-bounds selections reject without appending pages. An empty array adds nothing. `null`, omitted pages and `'all'` select every page.

FileReader failures, aborts and invalid results reject rather than leaving pending operations.

## Usage rules

- Await each `add()` call in the desired output order, then await saving. Do not mutate the same merger concurrently.
- Page numbers are one-based. Omit pages, pass `null`, or use `'all'` to copy all pages. Examples: `1`, `[1, 3]`, `'1,3'`, `'1-3'`, `'1 to 3'`. Selected pages are appended in the specified order. Use valid page numbers within the source document.
- `save()` and `saveAsBuffer()` do not reset the merger. Call synchronous `reset()` before starting an independent merge.
- `setMetadata()` accepts producer, author, title and creator. Await it before saving.
- Constructor options are forwarded to `@cantoo/pdf-lib` when loading inputs; defaults include `ignoreEncryption: true` and an empty password. Password-protected documents may require an explicit password.
- Catch rejected promises from the library for invalid input, failed fetches, parsing errors and invalid pages.
- Strings are URLs, not local filesystem paths. Pass a File from a file input for local documents. Remote URLs require browser fetch access and appropriate CORS headers.
- `saveAsBuffer()` returns Uint8Array, not Node Buffer. `saveAsBlob()` returns a PDF Blob. `save(name)` triggers a DOM download and appends `.pdf`; pass a name without that extension.
- `/web` and `/browser` are aliases of the default export. `/core` exposes PDFMergerBase and parsePagesString for reuse.
- Version 6 changed the original package default to the browser API. Use `@radui1398/pdf-merger-js-node` for Node and CLI integrations.

## Shared core API

```ts
import { PDFDocument, type LoadOptions } from '@cantoo/pdf-lib';
export type PdfInput = Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer | Blob | URL;
export type Pages = string | string[] | number | number[] | null;
export interface AddOptions {
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    timeoutMs?: number;
}
export interface Metadata {
    producer?: string;
    author?: string;
    title?: string;
    creator?: string;
}
export default class PDFMergerBase<Input = PdfInput> {
    protected _doc: PDFDocument | undefined;
    protected _loadOptions: LoadOptions;
    constructor(loadOptions?: LoadOptions);
    reset(): void;
    setMetadata(metadata: Metadata): Promise<void>;
    add(input: Input, pages?: Pages, options?: AddOptions): Promise<void>;
    protected _ensureDoc(): Promise<PDFDocument>;
    protected _saveAsUint8Array(): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>>;
    protected _saveAsBase64(): Promise<string>;
    protected _getInputAsUint8Array(input: unknown, options?: AddOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>;
}
```

## Core exports

```ts
export { default as PDFMergerBase } from './PDFMergerBase.js';
export type { PdfInput, Pages, Metadata, AddOptions } from './PDFMergerBase.js';
export { parsePagesString } from './parsePagesString.js';
```

## Page parser

```ts
export declare const MAX_SELECTED_PAGES = 100000;
export declare function validatePageNumber(value: unknown): number;
export declare function parsePagesString(pages: string, pageCount?: number): number[];
```

## Browser API

```ts
import type { AddOptions } from './core.js';
import PDFMergerBase from './PDFMergerBase.js';
export type { Pages, Metadata, AddOptions } from './core.js';
export type PdfInput = import('./core.js').PdfInput | File | String | string;
export default class PDFMerger extends PDFMergerBase<PdfInput> {
    protected _getInputAsUint8Array(input: PdfInput, options?: AddOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>;
    saveAsBuffer(): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>>;
    saveAsBlob(): Promise<Blob>;
    save(fileName: string): Promise<void>;
}
```
